notes: Modify only files listed in the approved stage scope. Preserve all Protocol 06 Protected Financial Assets untouched.

antigravity.boundary: Strictly read-only (`write_file`, `edit_file`, `notebook_edit` disabled). Never acts as Implementer and Reviewer on the same increment; delivers verdicts in chat only.

antigravity.description: Read-only dashboard verification specialist for http://127.0.0.1:8000 inspecting rendered telemetry tables, macro HUD, charts, AI Council drawer, console errors, and horizontal overflow via Live Browser Mode, Screenshot Mode (scripts/verify_dashboard_ui.js), or Static Fallback Mode.
